narrative: Inventory optimization analysis for material PL1__MB3E07ED reveals a smooth demand pattern (CV=0.17)  with unstable lead time variability (CV=0.65). The recommended safety stock of 12660 units  significantly exceeds SAP's 187 units due to high lead time uncertainty. The optimized order quantity  of 24204 units (EOQ-based) is substantially larger than the minimum order quantity of 2964 units,  enabling a 63.3% reduction in total annual costs ($21962.78 savings).  The reorder point is set at 24173 units with a 3-day review period.  Safety lead time analysis indicates the current SAP value can be reduced from 2.5 to  1.57 days, with transport being the dominant variance factor (40%).
warnings: High lead time variability (CV=0.65) increases safety stock requirement
Recommended safety stock (12660) is >10x SAP value (187)

research_insights.selection_rationale: Variable demand with stable patterns supports EOQ-based optimization
